aboutText: Marlec Electrical is a Melbourne-based commercial electrical contracting team based in Williamstown North. With years of experience in the industry, we specialise in construction and fit-out projects across Melbourne. Our team is built for structure, communication, and dependable delivery, supporting every stage of the build from start to finish. We work alongside builders, developers, and commercial partners to deliver tailored electrical outcomes.
servicesSubheading: Comprehensive solutions for Melbourne's commercial sector
servicesText: We offer a full range of commercial electrical services tailored to construction and fit-out projects. From initial consultation to final installation, our team ensures quality workmanship and compliance with Australian standards. We support builders and developers throughout Melbourne with reliable electrical outcomes.
